## Post-hoc robustness check: energy drawn by sleeping nodes (not pre-registered)

Each sleeping node pays f · L · Eelec per round (f = 1 equals the electronics energy of sending one packet). Always-on baselines have no sleeping nodes and are unchanged. Gains are CEB-ViTAL vs the strongest always-on baseline (by T90).
